text:
ada-mktg: Flag from weekly KPI review  Launch-posts show +3x impressions and headline CTR lift but "new MQLs" is down vs benchmark. Can analytics/ops sanity-check attribution and GA changes? :thinking_face:
tom-analytics: good catch. Quick context: we rolled GA4 parallel tracking last week and switched the dashboard source to the event-join view. If GA4 event names differ, join may drop some campaign tags. Pulling event-match shows some mismatches.
rachel-ops: we did deploy the GA4 shim (maps old 'utm_campaign' to new 'campaign_name') but only for web. Mobile SDK wasn't updated until yesterday. That could cause mobile-origin leads to be missing campaign_name in the analytics view.
jules-growth: also remember webinar promos were sent through the partner widget which uses 'referral_tag' instead of utm params. Dashboards join on campaign_name so those rows might be excluded.
tom-analytics: quick debug snippet I'm running: ```sql
-- counts by source_shim
SELECT source_shim, count(*) as regs, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM joined_events
WHERE campaign_family = 'q3_launch'
  AND event_date >= '2026-04-10'
GROUP BY 1;
```
deck-bot: Weekly KPI deck auto-upload: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch/q3-kpi (viewers: ada-mktg, jules-growth, tom-analytics)
ada-mktg: ok. For the deck narrative I want to be explicit: "Launch posts delivering strong attention; apparent MQL shortfall driven by GA4 parity gaps + partner widget attribution differences. Ops/Analytics are reconciling and backfilling; update expected in 48 hours." Keep it short for exec eyes.
rachel-ops: plan: (1) patch mobile SDK shim to populate campaign_name for last 7 days; (2) add mapping from referral_tag -> campaign_name for partner widget; (3) kick a targeted backfill rejoin for web/mobile/partner events. ETA ~6 hours for patch + backfill estimate.
tom-analytics: I'll run a before/after estimate and add a micro-card to the dashboard showing "percent leads with campaign_name" and "percent mobile leads missing campaign_name" so we detect this earlier. Also will compare 7d vs 14d attribution windows and publish delta table.
jules-growth: good. Also for the webinar planning team, please note registration spikes may not reflect immediate sales-ready volume because webinar->MQL conversion historically peaks at 5-8 days. We'll caveat the benchmark narrative accordingly.
adea-mktg: tiny wording tweak for the slide: "High engagement from launch posts and webinar promos; short-term MQL undercount due to GA4 parity & partner attribution. Ops/Analytics reconciling; numbers will be revalidated."
rachel-ops: kicking jobs now. I've also added an alert to the pipeline if campaign_name presence drops below 98% for major campaigns.
tom-analytics: backfill preview: if mappings are applied, expected MQLs for the period move from 146 -> ~312 (estimate). I'll paste the delta table in Slack when done.
jules-growth: love the micro-cards idea. That should stop headaches in next decks. Reconvene Friday AM after backfill so we can finalize the benchmark narrative. :calendar: :coffee:
